query: What identification strategies (staggered DiD, RDD, IV) best isolate narrative effects when narratives and events co-evolve?

response.query: What identification strategies (staggered DiD, RDD, IV) best isolate narrative effects when narratives and events co-evolve?
response.answer: Instrumental Variables (IV) best isolate narrative effects when narratives and events co-evolve. Staggered Difference-in-Differences (DiD) and Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) can also help but may be less effective. IV uses external instruments to address endogeneity.
